name: 91011 · La Canada, CA
findings: ZIP 91011 (La Canada) has 153 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91011 (La Canada) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91011 (La Canada) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 56 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
